about.title: This is your path to change
about.text: This program is a journey where, step by step, you cleanse the body, calm the mind and open space for deeper presence and inner transformation.
ayurveda.title: Ayurveda — the art of balanced living
ayurveda.text: Ayurveda is an ancient holistic science from India that views a person as a unified system of body, mind and spirit. Its goal is not just to relieve symptoms but to restore natural balance, strengthen vital energy and activate the body's self-healing capacities — living in harmony with the rhythms of nature.
pancakarma.title: What is Panchakarma?
pancakarma.col1.p1: Panchakarma is one of the oldest and deepest Ayurvedic methods of cleansing and healing, with roots in a tradition that goes back thousands of years.
pancakarma.col1.p2: It not only helps release accumulated burdens and toxins from the body, but also restores the natural flow of energy and balance, activating the body's self-healing processes. Unlike a symptomatic approach, Panchakarma works at a deeper level — helping you release the underlying causes of imbalance.
pancakarma.col2.p1: The program is tailored individually and includes 3.5–5 hours of carefully selected therapies each day: massages, treatment procedures, specialist consultations and medical supervision. Every participant receives a personal recovery plan and a suitable nutrition program.
pancakarma.col2.p2: This is an opportunity to fully stop, devote time to yourself and restore not only the body but also the balance of mind and inner state.
experience.title: What you will experience
exp.care.title: Daily care and a personal approach
exp.care.text: Each day you'll receive professional, individually tailored support that follows the responses and needs of your body. Combining ancient Ayurvedic knowledge with modern understanding, your recovery process is guided with deep attention and care.
exp.satsang.title: Spiritual practices and satsangs
exp.satsang.text: Satsangs are a space of being together and exploring the essential questions of life — about consciousness, the soul, God and the inner path. These gatherings help bring clarity, deeper understanding and inner peace.
exp.food.title: Deeply nourishing Ayurvedic cuisine
exp.food.text: Every meal is prepared to support the cleansing process and restore balance. The diet helps harmonize digestion, strengthen energy and create a natural sense of lightness in body and mind.
exp.nature.title: A healing environment in nature
exp.nature.text: Recovery takes place in a peaceful, nature-surrounded setting where silence and nature themselves become part of the therapy. This environment supports deep relaxation and inner balance.
exp.disconnect.title: Disconnect, to reconnect
exp.disconnect.text: A reduced amount of digital stimulation helps the mind quiet down and return to presence. Without information overload, attention naturally turns inward — thoughts become calmer and awareness clearer.
exp.temples.title: Visits to sacred sites and temples
exp.temples.text: During the journey you'll visit ancient, energetically powerful places where India's spiritual tradition is still alive. This experience deepens your connection to yourself and to the world around you.
exp.sea.title: Rest by the Arabian Sea
exp.sea.text: Meditation and time by the sea help restore inner balance, expand the senses and experience deep peace.
journey.title: During this time you will
journey.main: Experience Panchakarma — the core experience of the program, individually tailored for deep cleansing and renewal of the body.
journey.text: Step by step you'll restore the body's natural balance, develop health-supporting habits and gain a deeper understanding of how the mind and emotions work. You'll release accumulated inner patterns and blocks, experiencing ever greater lightness, clarity and inner peace.
journey.sub: This process is supported by other experiences:
journey.item1: Visits to sacred sites — ancient temples with strong spiritual energy
journey.item2: Satsangs — conversations about the soul, God and the meaning of life
journey.item3: Rest in nature — silence, peace and deep renewal in a natural setting
power.title: Places of power
power.intro: During the trip we plan to visit several significant and energetically powerful temples — gems of spiritual architecture where the breath of ancient Indian spirituality can still be felt today. Depending on conditions and the group's dynamics, some of these temples will be visited in person, giving you the chance to experience their unique atmosphere and power:
power.padma: Padmanabhaswamy temple — the wealthiest temple in the world, with treasures valued at more than €20 billion left as offerings by kings. One of the 108 Divya Desam temples with unique architecture and powerful energy, visited every day by thousands. The main deity is about 5.5 meters long and made from 12,008 Saligrams.
power.kanya: Kanyakumari is a sacred place at the very southern tip of India, where three waters meet — the Indian Ocean, the Arabian Sea and the Bay of Bengal. The goddess Parvati is worshipped in the temple as the eternal maiden — a symbol of strength, purity and victory over evil. The sea around this place is considered holy, and sunrises and sunsets here are particularly special, embodying the goddess's radiance and divine presence.
power.aazhimala: Aazhimala Shiva temple — a majestic Shiva temple on the ocean shore with breathtaking views.
parmums.title: About us
parmums.more.p1: Yatra is a carefully designed experience for those seeking more than a journey — for those seeking depth, authenticity and inner transformation.
parmums.more.p2: We are a team of spiritual seekers with a refined understanding of what pilgrimage really is. Combining many years of experience, carefully chosen destinations and deep knowledge of ancient traditions, we create unique journeys that go beyond the usual tourist experience.
parmums.more.p3: The pilgrimages and retreats we offer lead to authentic, energetically powerful places — places you won't find in guidebooks. They are places where time stops, where ancient knowledge opens up and where you can experience a true connection with yourself.
parmums.more.p4: Every journey with Yatra is carefully crafted down to the smallest detail — from the chosen places to the experienced guidance and the atmosphere that allows you to fully disconnect from the outside world and turn toward your inner path.
parmums.more.p5: We believe that true luxury lies not in outer attributes but in the chance to pause, feel and transform.
parmums.more.p6: Sacred places, authentic knowledge and guided experience together create a space where deep inner change is possible. This experience naturally reflects in every area of life — in relationships, work, well-being and overall quality of life.
parmums.more.p7: Yatra is created for those who choose quality, depth and truth.
parmums.more.p8: For those who don't want to be mere travelers but conscious participants in the experience.
parmums.more.p9: Our programs are individually designed for spiritual seekers who value authenticity, a personal approach and a transformative experience. We create an environment where it's possible to fully open up, renew yourself and continue on your path with clarity and inner strength.
leaders.title: Group leaders
leaders.intro: The group is led by experienced spiritual teachers who, over many years, have deeply explored India's spiritual traditions and Ayurvedic practices.
leaders.swami.name: Swami Sharada
leaders.swami.p1: Swami received his first higher education at the Institute of Asian and African Studies (ISAA, Moscow State University), where he studied South Asian languages, cultures, history and economics. During his studies he became equally interested in Christianity and Hinduism, sensing in both religions one shared central principle — the teaching of unconditional love.
leaders.swami.p2: This deep interest in God led him to Paramahamsa Vishwananda, whom he met and accepted as his Satguru in 2011. In 2013, during the Kumbh Mela festival in India, he received initiation into the order of swamis.
leaders.swami.p3: His way of life is service to people and teaching the path of devotion to the Divine through daily prayer, Atma Kriya Yoga, rituals and life within modern society and the spiritual community, based on the teaching of Paramahamsa Vishwananda. He is the head of the Bhakti Marga ashram in Latvia.
leaders.toms.name: Toms Liepiņš
leaders.toms.text: A lecturer who has taught at the University of Latvia, BA School of Business and Finance and other institutions. He currently teaches Atma Kriya Yoga as well as various Vedic teachings. At the same time he works in the financial sector and runs his own business. He has been to India more than 20 times. Toms helps people find inner peace, true unconditional love, clarity about the meaning of life and a deeper connection with themselves and others.
leaders.note: Over many years they have explored and assessed different Panchakarma options across India in search of a truly authentic and high-quality experience. In their view, this retreat and the chosen clinic are among the very best — a place where professional approach, authentic knowledge and real healing come together.
clinic.title: Ayurvedic clinic
clinic.subtitle: We're going to one of the world's finest Ayurvedic clinics
clinic.text1: We will stay at a clinic recognized as one of the best in the world — a place recommended by many who have already been there and regularly return to restore their health after intense work routines. This is your chance to spend time in a true oasis of recovery and healing.
clinic.text2: We'll stay in comfortable double rooms with all amenities, giving ourselves over to complete rest and renewal of the body.
rooms.title: Stay
rooms.intro: Three different accommodation options are available on the clinic grounds. Choose what suits you best — from authentic Kerala cottages to spacious Deluxe rooms.
rooms.standard.title: Standard room
rooms.standard.text: A comfortable double room with all the necessary amenities. Simple, cozy and practical — included in the base program price.
rooms.standard.full: The Standard room is a comfortable double room in the clinic's main building. It has either two single beds or one double bed with a mosquito net, a desk, a wardrobe and a fully equipped bathroom. It's a simple, cozy and practical choice — all the necessary amenities are included in the base program price. Ideal for those who want to spend most of their time on treatments and practices rather than in the room.
rooms.deluxe.title: Deluxe room
rooms.deluxe.text: A spacious, light-filled room in the clinic's new wing with a view of the pool and garden. A higher level of comfort, modern interior and all necessary amenities for those who want a more exclusive experience.
rooms.deluxe.full: The Deluxe room is located in the clinic's new wing — more spacious, modern and at a higher level of comfort. The room has a comfortable double bed with a mosquito net, a bright lounge area, a large bathroom and access to a terrace overlooking the pool and tropical garden. Air conditioning is available on request for an additional fee. This is the ideal choice for those who want more exclusive accommodation during the retreat.
rooms.cottage.title: Kerala cottages
rooms.cottage.text: Traditional Kerala-style cottages set in a garden surrounded by palm trees. An authentic atmosphere and a direct connection with nature — a great choice for those seeking peace and a unique sense of place.
rooms.cottage.full: The Kerala cottages are traditional houses built in Kerala style, set in a garden surrounded by palms and tropical plants. Each cottage offers a peaceful, private atmosphere with authentic character and a direct connection to nature. The interior is simple yet cozy — with wooden materials, natural fabrics and a bright lounge area. A great choice for those seeking a deeper immersion in the Indian setting and the silence of nature.
rooms.note: Room availability and the final price are confirmed after you submit your application. Contact us to choose the option that suits you best.

pil.hero.title: South India
pil.contact.intro: Apply early — places are limited. Fill out the form and we'll get back to you.
pil.about.title: Where nature, history and spirituality merge
pil.about.text1: South India — the states of Kerala and Tamil Nadu — is a place where nature, history and spirituality flow together in one rhythm. These regions are known for their lush tropical forests, palm trees, broad waterfalls and calm beaches, which have created an ideal setting for meditation and spiritual practice for centuries.
pil.about.text2: Ancient cultural traditions live here, where temple architecture, sacred rituals and music are woven into everyday life. A journey through South India lets you not only discover the wealth of this land but also feel its peace, vibrancy and energy — directed both toward inner cleansing and toward a deeper connection with local traditions and the divine.
pil.highlights.title: What you will experience on the journey
pil.h.divya.title: Divya Desam temples
pil.h.divya.text: We'll visit at least 15 of the 108 special Vishnu temples, located mainly in South India. Each place carries its own unique energy and legend.
pil.h.padma.title: Padmanabhaswamy temple
pil.h.padma.text: One of the wealthiest temples in the world, dedicated to the god Vishnu reclining on a serpent. In its vaults, gold, silver and gemstones worth over $20 billion have been discovered.
pil.h.guruvayur.title: Guruvayur temple
pil.h.guruvayur.text: An important Krishna temple known as “Bhooloka Vaikuntha” — Vishnu's heaven on earth. Prayers offered here are believed to be answered with special swiftness.
pil.h.kanya.title: Kanyakumari and the three seas
pil.h.kanya.text: A sacred place where the Indian Ocean, the Arabian Sea and the Bay of Bengal meet. In the temple, the goddess Parvati is worshipped as the eternal maiden — a symbol of strength and victory over evil.
pil.h.rames.title: Rameshwaram
pil.h.rames.text: One of the four special temples in India — Char Dham. This Shiva temple is visited daily by thousands of pilgrims. Rituals at the 22 sacred wells make this place very special. The Ramanathaswamy temple — one of the 12 most sacred Jyotirlingams — and an early-morning swim in the ocean.
pil.h.viveka.title: Vivekananda Memorial
pil.h.viveka.text: A meditation rock in the ocean where Swami Vivekananda meditated for three days in 1892. From the rock you can see the meeting point of the three seas.
pil.h.meena.title: Meenakshi Amman temple
pil.h.meena.text: In Madurai. Famous for its splendid architecture and rich mythology of the goddess Meenakshi and Shiva — the union of feminine and masculine power.
pil.h.kathakali.title: Kathakali performance
pil.h.kathakali.text: A traditional performance in Kochi, where stories from the Mahabharata and Ramayana are told through expressive makeup, gestures and music.
pil.h.boat.title: Boat ride in Kovalam
pil.h.boat.text: A peaceful boat ride through tropical lagoons, palm-lined shores and mangrove trees — unhurried, simply observing the surroundings.

privacy.intro: How we process your personal data when you contact us through the contact form.
privacy.p1: This site and brand Yatra.lv is run by a team that organizes Ayurvedic retreats and pilgrimages to India. For questions about personal data processing, write to info@yatra.lv — we reply ourselves.
privacy.p2: When filling in the contact form, we receive the following information:
privacy.l2.4: Selected journey and number of participants
privacy.l2.6: IP address — automatically, to protect the form from bots (Cloudflare Turnstile)
privacy.l3.1: respond to your inquiry and provide information about the journey;
privacy.l3.3: protect the website from spam and bots.
privacy.p3.nopay: Payments and banking data are not processed on the site.
privacy.p3.basis: Legal basis for processing — your consent (GDPR Regulation 2016/679, Article 6(1)(a)) and our legitimate interests (maintaining a secure site and responding to inquiries).
privacy.p4.intro: To make the site work, some data is processed by our service providers:
privacy.l4.3: Vercel (USA) — for hosting and serving the site.
privacy.p4.scc: Data transfers outside the EU are based on Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission.
privacy.p5: We keep your inquiry until it's resolved, plus up to 12 months so we can respond to any follow-up questions. After that period, the data is deleted.
privacy.p6.intro: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to:
privacy.l6.1: access your data and receive a copy of it;
privacy.l6.5: file a complaint with the Latvian Data State Inspectorate.
privacy.p6.contact: To exercise these rights, write to info@yatra.lv.
privacy.p7: The site does not use tracking cookies or analytics tools. In the browser's localStorage we only save your chosen language so that the site shows the right language on your next visit. This information is not personal and is not sent anywhere.
privacy.p8: This policy may be updated. The current version is always available on this page. Last updated: May 2026.
